def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    
    # Penalize bins that are too full (small remaining space) quadratically
    underutilized = remaining < 0.1 * bins
    priorities[underutilized & valid] = -(remaining[underutilized & valid] ** 2)
    
    # Penalize bins with very large remaining space (wasted capacity) exponentially
    overutilized = remaining > 0.5 * bins
    priorities[overutilized & valid] = -np.exp(-remaining[overutilized & valid])
    
    # Reward bins with moderate remaining space (ideal balance)
    moderate = ~underutilized & ~overutilized & valid
    priorities[moderate] = -((remaining[moderate] - 0.3 * bins[moderate]) ** 2)
    
    # Invert so higher priority means smaller negative score (better fit)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    # Target remaining capacity is proportional to cube root of bin capacity
    target_remaining = np.cbrt(bins) * 0.5  # Scale factor for balance
    distance = np.abs(remaining[valid] - target_remaining[valid])
    # Invert distance with smoothing to assign higher priority to better fits
    priorities[valid] = 1 / (distance + 1e-10)
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    # Mask out bins that cannot fit the item
    valid = remaining_capacity >= 0
    # Initialize priorities with zeros
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    # For valid bins, compute priority as inverse of absolute deviation from optimal remaining capacity (item size)
    optimal_remaining = item  # Ideal remaining space after placing item
    deviations = np.abs(remaining_capacity[valid] - optimal_remaining)
    # Avoid division by zero; add small epsilon
    priorities[valid] = 1.0 / (deviations + 1e-8)
    return priorities
